applicability: Curator handoffs declaring a successor of an existing family while adding a genuine obligation and selecting unchanged sibling support.
conditions: Each selected sibling is named by an exact stored membership UUID and a nonblank curator-authored basis in the declaration’s retain_memberships list.

Each selected membership exists in the selected dataset, belongs to an explicitly declared predecessor revision of the same family, and resolves to a unique successor-family/invariant-revision endpoint.
Omitted or empty retention selects no old members; malformed, absent, mismatched or duplicate references refuse the affected authoring.
exclusions: No automatic predecessor-roster inheritance, latest-head selection, label-based grouping or replay of another leaf’s allocation.
This is not a standalone family-only operation or authority to bypass the existing admitted writer.
statement: The curator explicitly selects retained siblings by exact stored membership identity and an authored basis; omission retains none rather than copying a predecessor roster.
